title: Fort Douglas Museum
geometryBasis: The museum’s main sandstone gallery and its occupied porch, registered to the named Dumke building footprint and documented Potter Street frontage.
sectionBasis: Mapped front and rear outline, National Register single-storey masonry and gabled roof facts, and the original Qualla 2022 photo for the porch section and visible materials.
limitations: This is the Ezekiel R. Dumke Jr. main museum gallery at 1990 East Potter Street. The adjacent Kauffman barrack and the remainder of the fort are separate buildings.

Map geometry controls the exterior plan. Roof pitch, rear openings, porch floor height, sign lettering and weathered sandstone tones are estimated from the documented building and the street photograph.
Original public terrain was preserved. Step height and the masonry meeting the ground are approximate.
